mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cms_cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_cart_item (member_id, product_id, product_sku_id, product_name, product_image, product_price, quantity, sku_attributes, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productSkuId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{productPrice}, #{quantity}, #{skuAttributes}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_cart_item SET delete_status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cms_cart_item SET delete_status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
